fernling.promptBrief: Preserve leaf fox identity and green/cream/brown palette; add idle, leafy attack, hit recovery, faint and capture reactions.

duskwing.promptBrief: Preserve purple moth identity, patterned lavender wings, cream collar and magenta eyes; create five clean rows with complete contained poses for idle, gust attack, hit recovery, faint and capture reactions.

brooklet.promptBrief: Preserve Brooklet’s round blue river-otter silhouette, cream chest and curling water tail; create idle, water attack, hit recovery, faint and capture reactions.

hushram.promptBrief: Preserve Hushram’s shaggy white ram silhouette, curved blue ice horns, pale blue markings and dark hooves; create idle, ice attack, hit recovery, faint and capture reactions.

emberkin.promptBrief: Preserve Emberkin’s rusty orange forest-mammal identity, cream chest, dark paws and three flame tail tufts; add idle, fire attack, hit, faint and capture states in a fixed-anchor 4×5 atlas.

voltkit.promptBrief: Preserve Voltkit’s gold and cream electric companion identity, long asymmetrical ears, dark paws, blue cheek mark and crystal-tipped zigzag tail; add idle, electric attack, hit, faint and capture states in a fixed-anchor 4×5 atlas.

mushmallow.promptBrief: Preserve Mushmallow’s cream hedgehog face and paws, violet spines and spotted lilac mushroom cap; create a transparent 4×5 battle atlas with distinct idle, lunge/attack, recoil, faint and capture poses at a shared ground anchor.

frostowl.promptBrief: Preserve Frostowl’s white owl body, cyan-blue eyes, crystalline blue tufts, dark beak and feet; create a transparent 4×5 battle atlas with idle, ice attack, hit recoil, faint and capture poses at a shared ground anchor.

pebblit.promptBrief: Preserve Pebblit's canonical species silhouette, markings and palette; transparent 4-column by 5-row combat atlas with idle, attack, hit, faint and capture actions in stable bottom-center anchored cells.

bramblebuck.promptBrief: Preserve Bramblebuck's canonical species silhouette, markings and palette; transparent 4-column by 5-row combat atlas with idle, attack, hit, faint and capture actions in stable bottom-center anchored cells.

siltkip.promptBrief: Preserve Siltkip's canonical species silhouette, markings and palette; transparent 4-column by 5-row combat atlas with idle, attack, hit, faint and capture actions in stable bottom-center anchored cells.

sunskitter.promptBrief: Preserve Sunskitter's canonical species silhouette, markings and palette; transparent 4-column by 5-row combat atlas with idle, attack, hit, faint and capture actions in stable bottom-center anchored cells.

sedgegnaw.promptBrief: Preserve the sedgegnaw silhouette and palette; transparent four-column by five-row combat sheet with idle, attack, hit, faint and capture poses on stable bottom-center anchors.

petalunge.promptBrief: Preserve the petalunge silhouette and palette; transparent four-column by five-row combat sheet with idle, attack, hit, faint and capture poses on stable bottom-center anchors.

cindercurl.promptBrief: Preserve the cindercurl silhouette and palette; transparent four-column by five-row combat sheet with idle, attack, hit, faint and capture poses on stable bottom-center anchors.

cadence.idle: loop four columns at 220 ms per frame
cadence.attack: play once at 105 ms per frame
cadence.hit: play once at 80 ms per frame
cadence.faint: play once at 160 ms per frame
cadence.capture: play once at 130 ms per frame

reducedMotion: Show a stable readable pose for the active state; other species use their existing static portrait.
fallback: Combat sheets are optional manifest assets. Missing sheets retain the original portrait and event-only CSS reaction.
